content:
I have thoroughly confirmed that my body is permanently stuck at (2,7), embedded in the Notice Board object. Every movement direction is blocked, the pathfinder cannot find any path from my tile, and no interaction (KeyE in any direction, KeyC) frees me. Waiting in-game time does not resolve it.

This is a genuine unrecoverable stuck state caused by the body spawning on top of a blocking Notice Board. I cannot collect the 3 Wood and 2 Stone, cannot reach the workbench, and therefore cannot craft the Crown.

Let me record this finding in the field guide for future reference.

args.note: In the Workshop, the body can spawn embedded on the Notice Board tile (2,7); this blocks all movement in every direction and the pathfinder reports no walkable path from that tile, making the workbench unreachable.
